mapper.sql: cms_topic.status = 1 and cms_topic.user_status = 1 and cms_topic.del_flag = 0 and cms_topic.is_template = 0 and coalesce(cms_topic.club_member_only, 0) = 0 and and (cms_topic.club_id is null or cms_topic.club_id = 0 or exists ( select 1 from club catalog_club where catalog_club.id = cms_topic.club_id and catalog_club.del_flag = 0 ))

cms_topic.id as id, cms_topic.city_code as cityCode, cms_topic.name as name, cms_topic.subtitle as subtitle, left(cms_topic.description, 240) as description, cms_topic.img_url as imgUrl, cms_topic.product_type as productType, cms_topic.total_time as totalTime, cms_topic.total_mileage as totalMileage, cms_topic.location_count as locationCount, cms_topic.lifecycle as lifecycle, cms_topic.self_play as selfPlay, cms_topic.self_play_price as selfPlayPrice, cms_topic.team_mode as teamMode, cms_topic.sale_end_at as saleEndAt, cms_topic.end_date as endDate, cms_topic.club_id as clubId, cms_topic.published_config_version as publishedConfigVersion, case when cms_topic.published_theme_runtime_config_json is null then null else '1' end as publishedThemeRuntimeConfigJson, cms_topic.update_time as updateTime, clm.landing_summary as landingSummary, clm.source_locale as sourceLocale, clm.group_eligible as groupEligible, clm.school_eligible as schoolEligible, clm.group_min_people as groupMinPeople, clm.group_max_people as groupMaxPeople, clm.age_min as ageMin, clm.age_max as ageMax, clm.accessibility_note as accessibilityNote, clt.title as translatedTitle, clt.subtitle as translatedSubtitle, clt.summary as translatedSummary

left join content_landing_metadata clm on clm.topic_id = cms_topic.id and clm.status = 1 left join content_landing_translation clt on clt.topic_id = cms_topic.id and clt.locale = #{locale} and clt.translation_state = 'APPROVED'

sql.if: and (cms_topic.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cms_topic.subtitle like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and (clm.age_min is not null or clm.age_max is not null) and (clm.age_min is null or clm.age_min <= #{audienceAge}) and (clm.age_max is null or clm.age_max >= #{audienceAge})
and cms_topic.total_time is not null and cms_topic.total_time >= #{minMinutes}
and cms_topic.total_time is not null and cms_topic.total_time <= #{maxMinutes}

and exists (select 1 from oms_ticket catalog_ticket where catalog_ticket.owner_type = 1 and catalog_ticket.owner_id = cms_topic.id and catalog_ticket.del_flag = 0 and catalog_ticket.sub_type = 'guided')
and cms_topic.club_id is not null and cms_topic.club_id > 0

choose.when: order by cms_topic.total_time is null, cms_topic.total_time asc, cms_topic.id desc
order by cms_topic.total_time is null, cms_topic.total_time desc, cms_topic.id desc
choose.otherwise: order by cms_topic.update_time desc, cms_topic.id desc

mapper.select:
select from cms_topic
where cms_topic.id = #{topicId} and

select from cms_topic
where cms_topic.id in #{topicId} and

select cms_topic.id as id, cms_topic.name as name, cms_topic.city_code as cityCode, cms_topic.img_url as imgUrl, cms_topic.location_count as locationCount, cms_topic.update_time as updatedAt, cast(node.latitude as decimal(12,7)) as latitude, cast(node.longitude as decimal(12,7)) as longitude from cms_topic join cms_topic_node node on node.topic_id = cms_topic.id and node.status = 1 and node.latitude is not null and node.latitude <> '' and node.longitude is not null and node.longitude <> '' and node.id = (select probe.id from cms_topic_node probe where probe.topic_id = cms_topic.id and probe.status = 1 and probe.latitude is not null and probe.latitude <> '' and probe.longitude is not null and probe.longitude <> '' order by probe.sort_id asc, probe.id asc limit 1) where cms_topic.id in #{topicId} and
select chapter.name as chapterName from cms_topic_chapter chapter where chapter.topic_id = #{topicId} order by chapter.sort_id asc, chapter.id asc
select chapter.topic_id as topicId, count(*) as chapterCount from cms_topic_chapter chapter where chapter.topic_id in #{topicId} group by chapter.topic_id
select chapter.id as chapterId, chapter.name as chapterName from cms_topic_chapter chapter where chapter.topic_id = #{topicId} order by chapter.sort_id asc, chapter.id asc limit 1

select node.name as name, case when node.hook_text is not null and node.hook_text <> '' then node.hook_text when node.description is not null then left(node.description, 40) else null end as hookTeaser from cms_topic_node node join cms_topic_chapter chapter on chapter.id = node.chapter_id and chapter.topic_id = node.topic_id where node.topic_id = #{topicId} and node.status = 1 and chapter.id = (select first_chapter.id from cms_topic_chapter first_chapter where first_chapter.topic_id = #{topicId} order by first_chapter.sort_id asc, first_chapter.id asc limit 1) order by node.sort_id asc, node.id asc limit #{limit}

select ticket.owner_id as topicId, min(ticket.price) as minTicketPrice, sum(case when ticket.sub_type = 'guided' then 1 else 0 end) as guidedCount from oms_ticket ticket where ticket.owner_type = 1 and ticket.del_flag = 0 and ticket.price is not null and ticket.owner_id in #{topicId} group by ticket.owner_id
select snapshot.topic_id as topicId, snapshot.id as saleSnapshotId, snapshot.frozen_at as frozenAt from topic_sale_snapshot snapshot where snapshot.topic_id in #{topicId}

select translation.topic_id as topicId, translation.locale as locale from content_landing_translation translation where translation.translation_state = 'APPROVED' and translation.topic_id in #{topicId} order by translation.topic_id asc, translation.locale asc

select cms_topic.city_code as cityCode, case when count(distinct nullif(trim(club.city), '')) = 1 then min(nullif(trim(club.city), '')) else null end as cityName from cms_topic join club on club.id = cms_topic.club_id and club.del_flag = 0 where cms_topic.city_code in #{cityCode} and club.city is not null and trim(club.city) <> '' group by cms_topic.city_code
